taxonomy.note: Current Kew accepts Grindelia nuda; Grindelia squarrosa var. nuda is a homotypic synonym.

target_zone_range.evidence_basis: Hays — Natural Purola flora lists Grindelia nuda var. nuda as naturally occurring. Williamson — county flora documents Grindelia squarrosa var. nuda, a synonym of current Grindelia nuda. Burnet — detailed county treatment documents the same synonym/current concept.
target_zone_range.guardrail: Historic var. nuda records are counted only after explicit synonym reconciliation to current Grindelia nuda.

morphology.look_here_first: Start with the head: curlytop gumweed is typically rayless, with only yellow disc florets surrounded by many narrow spreading to ascending resin-gland-tipped phyllaries. Vegetative parts are strongly gland-dotted and aromatic.
diagnostic_traits: glabrous to nearly glabrous gland-dotted shoots
many narrow spreading to ascending phyllaries with resinous tips
